sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:36

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:36:1
items.html:
Mati [reaching] in Keter, and then the light of Hochma returned and was concealed in Keter: The meaning is that when Hochma refined, and the light of her male and female departed and rose to Keter, then the Nukva of Keter returned and thickened in her coarseness of phase three, and once again an upper coupling was made on the light of phase three, and the light of the level of Hochma was drawn once more to the vessel of Keter, and the light is found to be Mati again in Keter.
And the reason for this is the male of Hochma that rose to the vessel of Keter, which is the aspect of the record that remained from the first expansion, of the coarseness of phase three that was there. Therefore, since it rose and was included in the female of Keter, who had likewise been in the aspect of the coarseness of phase three before she refined, now, because of the ascent of the male of Hochma, her former coarseness returned to her, and the upper coupling returned upon her.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:36:2
items.html: Hochma turned its face to Keter and gave it its light. That is, that Hochma turned her face upward toward Keter, and after this she returned and refined also of her phase two, and the level of Bina vanished from her and came to Keter, as above. For before this he says that Hochma turned her face downward to Bina, which is because of the refinement of the male of Hochma; and he informs us that after Bina received the remainder of the male of Hochma, the vessel of Hochma afterwards returned and turned her face toward Keter, since there was still in her the light of the level of Bina in the coarseness of phase two, of which she had not yet refined. But after she turned her face to Keter, then her time came to refine of phase two as well, and the light of the level of Bina, too, vanished, and she gave it to Keter, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:36:3
items.html: The light of Bina that was in Hochma does not ascend with it to Keter. Meaning the light of ZA, which belongs to the vessel of Bina; for the light of Bina does not belong now, in the second expansion, to Bina, but to Hochma, as above. And this is what he says, that the vessel of Hochma gave her light to Keter, that is, her light of Bina, which is because she refined of phase two, as above, and nothing remained in her but the coarseness of phase one alone, which is the light of the level of ZA, belonging to the vessel of Bina. And of this light he says that it remained in the vessel of Hochma and did not ascend to Keter; but since it belongs to the vessel of Bina, the ARI calls it by the name of the light of Bina.
